label: Priority
description: How urgent a record is, chosen from an ordered choice list (P1 critical to P4 low) and rendered as a tone badge. Priority drives sorting, views, and notifications. Use single_select for unordered classifications.
usage: Order options from most to least urgent; list order is the sort order.
Give each option a tone (accent.red for P1, accent.amber for P2, accent.blue for P3, accent.gray for P4).
Set a sensible default (usually P3) so new records are never unprioritized.
constraints: choiceList is required; option order defines sort order.
default, when set, must be an option ID of that list.
The stored value is the option ID; badges always show the label text as well as the tone.

valueSchema.description: Stable option ID from the priority choice list.

binding.description: Rendered by a field placement node bound to a field of this type.

accessibility.keyboard: Alt+Down or Enter opens the list; typing filters; Up/Down move; Enter selects; Esc closes and keeps the previous value.
accessibility.notes: Each option announces its label and position ("P1 Critical, 1 of 4"); tone is never the only cue.

responsive: Badge in read mode; full-width select when editing.
